fields.label: Service
fields.description: The API behind the gateway with its version, for example assetmanagement/v3.

fields.label: Resource
fields.description: The collection inside the service, for example assets.

fields.label: Lookup
fields.description: Path: GET <resource>/<id>. Filter: GET <resource>?filter={"<key>":"<value>"} for a record addressed by another field, or by several.

fields.label: Key Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated, in the order used in External ID (values joined by |). One field for a Path lookup.

fields.label: Label Field
fields.description: Dotted path to the text shown for the record, for example name or location.locality.
